training_origin.observed_training_pattern: 15 of 21 clades with fine-to-coarse compression opportunity had positive AUC_fine - AUC_coarse; median tilt +0.01998

frozen_hierarchy.fine: six-bit anthocyanidin presence pattern in fixed order Pelargonidin/Cyanidin/Peonidin/Delphinidin/Petunidin/Malvidin

opportunity_rule: fine_state_count > coarse_state_count on the frozen common frame
sequential_outcome_opening: clear exact source and authoritative-tree provenance gate
freeze exact tree bytes/hash, phylo_ID crosswalk and sample-to-species rule
open HPLC rows only under the existing preregistration and construct the frozen common frame
record retained fine/intermediate/coarse state counts and determine compression opportunity before computing any AUC
only then compute the already-frozen AUC and joint-permutation statistics

prediction_if_no_opportunity.rationale: identical fine and coarse partitions on the retained tips necessarily yield identical same-state labels and AUCs

prediction_if_opportunity.null: AUC_fine <= AUC_coarse under joint state-triplet permutation
prediction_if_opportunity.pass_rule: observed contrast > 0 and one-sided joint-permutation p <= 0.05
prediction_if_opportunity.fail_rule: compression opportunity exists but the pass rule is not met

permutation_unit: jointly permute each species complete coarse/intermediate/fine state triplet across retained tips
no_post_hoc_rescue: do not merge or split compound states after outcome opening
do not relax the rare fine-state minimum of 5
do not change the common retained-tip frame
do not substitute visible hue or continuous HPLC magnitude
do not substitute a non-authoritative phylogeny
do not change from fine-versus-coarse to another contrast after seeing AUCs
claim_if_pass: In one held-out biochemical radiation with pre-existing representation opportunity, fine compound identity preserves more same-state phylogenetic structure than the coarse any-pigment partition under the frozen estimator.
claim_if_fail: The retrospective visible-color opportunity-to-fine-tilt tendency does not prospectively generalize to this held-out biochemical radiation under the frozen estimator.
claim_ceiling: one Ruellia result cannot establish a universal fine-resolution rule
a PASS validates the conditional opportunity-realization prediction, not the earlier intermediate-optimum hypothesis
a structural zero-opportunity outcome is not a biological negative or success
a source/tree/common-frame HOLD is not a biological negative
